## Why it was silent

Unblocking the cooldown was necessary but not sufficient here. The stock emitter (sub_41B250) is unreachable for a human driver — four designed live runs disproved the three suspected gates. So this feature also needs the DLL, which watches for the retirement the game itself performs and injects the event the emitter would have chosen.

## Rebuild

```bash
C:\msys64\mingw32\bin\gcc.exe -shared -O2 -Wall \
    -o player_retire_commentary.dll player_retire_commentary.c -lkernel32
```

`source.c` writes the same bytes the manifest would write to the .exe,
but into the running process at DLL attach — so no game file is
modified and not loading the DLL is the uninstall. Each site verifies
its expected original bytes first and skips on mismatch, so a different
game build is a no-op rather than a corruption.
